verdict.rationale: Kit is an email marketing platform, so automatic suppression of unsubscribes, bounces, and complaints is an applicable axis. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents automatic suppression or how it is honored across broadcasts, sequences, and automations. The closest item is broadcast stats reporting unsubscribe counts and rates, which is analytics rather than suppression, and nothing covers bounce or spam-complaint handling or CAN-SPAM/GDPR defaults.
